description: Gerrard Capashen is a Benalish soldier and heir to Urza's Legacy who became captain of the Skyship Weatherlight and died stopping Yawgmoth.

summary.text: Gerrard Capashen is a Benalish soldier and heir to Urza's Legacy who became captain of the Skyship Weatherlight and died stopping Yawgmoth.

bio.text: His family was murdered by Phyrexian raiders and Karn took him to Sidar Kondo, who adopted him and raised him beside his son Vuel.

citations.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Karn", section "The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Sidar Kondo (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: After Vuel's rite of passage was ruined, Vuel was cast out and later became Volrath, who stole Gerrard's Legacy and became his greatest enemy.

citations.text: "Volrath", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Gerrard joined Sisay's Weatherlight crew with Rofellos and Mirri, then quit after Rofellos was killed at Crovax's Estate, and later returned when the crew came for him to rescue Sisay.

citations.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Sisay and the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Gerrard Capashen", section "Sisay and the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: On Rath he reanimated Karn, was proclaimed the Korvecdal by the Oracle en-Vec, and helped free Sisay and retake the Legacy before the crew escaped to Mercadia.

citations.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In Mercadia he trained the magistrate's soldiers, realized he was on the wrong side and ordered hostilities to stop, and then helped the rebels reclaim the Weatherlight.

citations.text: "Rushwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Rushwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the Phyrexian invasion Tsabo Tavoc used his grief to control his mind, and later Crovax took him to Phyrexia, where he pledged loyalty to Yawgmoth in hope of Hanna's return.

citations.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Yawgmoth forced him to fight Urza, whom he beheaded, and he escaped carrying Urza's head and killed Crovax in the Stronghold.

citations.text: "Phyrexia", section "Urza vs. Gerrard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Urza", section "Final Atonement". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He placed Urza's powerstone eyes in Karn's chest to complete the Legacy Weapon, and he died in its activation, which destroyed Yawgmoth and made Karn a planeswalker.

citations.text: "Karn", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Gerrard is dead, having died in the Legacy Weapon's activation, and later stories remember him as a martyred Weatherlight captain whose final act ensured his legacy would never die.

citations.text: "Urza", section "Final Atonement". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.
Commander 2019: card flavor text (Commander 2019, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza creates golems animated with the word EMETH while dueling Gerrard in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: he created several golems that he brought to life by inscribing them with the word EMETH

citation.text: "Golem", section "Thran Golems". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard returns to the Weatherlight as captain in Sisay's absence after serving in the Benalish army.
timeline.quote: Now, after serving nobly in the Benalish army, he has returned to the *Weatherlight* to serve as captain in Sisay's absence

citation.text: Gerrard (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Karn accidentally takes a life while protecting the young Gerrard and vows never to kill again.
timeline.quote: Karn accidentally took the life of another.

citation.text: Karn (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri rejoins Gerrard aboard the Weatherlight as his unofficial first mate.
timeline.quote: she rejoined Gerrard aboard the *Weatherlight* as his unofficial first mate

citation.text: Mirri (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay undertakes a quest for the Legacy and continues it when Gerrard abandons it.
timeline.quote: She continued this quest even when Gerrard, heir to the Legacy, chose to abandon it.

citation.text: Sisay (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath stole Gerrard's Legacy and sold it off piece by piece.
timeline.quote: Volrath stole Gerrard's Legacy and rose to power selling it off piece by piece.

citation.text: Volrath (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Multani taught Gerrard, Mirri and Rofellos to hone spellcasting alongside physical discipline.
timeline.quote: Multani taught Gerrard, Mirri, and Rofellos to hone their spellcasting in tandem with more physical disciplines

citation.text: Multani (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Oracle believes Gerrard to be the Korvecdal.
timeline.quote: She believes Gerrard to be the *Korvecdal*, the one who will unite the people of Rath against Volrath's tyranny.

citation.text: Oracle (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sidar Kondo raised Gerrard alongside his son Vuel, who became malicious.
timeline.quote: Vuel's bitterness led him to become an equally devastating force of malice.

citation.text: Sidar Kondo (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke lies to Gerrard that he had to kill, and pledges loyalty.
timeline.quote: "I killed him because I had to," Starke lied to Gerrard. "But now I pledge my loyalty to you."

citation.text: Debt of Loyalty (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay declares the Lord of the Wastes must be destroyed.
timeline.quote: "The Lord of the Wastes must be destroyed; I am bound to this destiny by the chains of fate. If only Gerrard would see his part."

citation.text: Mana Chains (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard threatens a gatekeeper to pass the gate.
timeline.quote: "There are two ways for me to pass this gate. One involves you remaining conscious."

citation.text: Abyssal Gatekeeper (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight banks as an aboroth rises to crush a lone rider.
timeline.quote: The *Weatherlight* banked sharply as the colossal beast rose up to crush the lone rider.

citation.text: Aboroth (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard uses the Thran Forge to strengthen the aboroth, calling out to the elves.
timeline.quote: "This will work," Gerrard called to the elves as he used the forge to strengthen the aboroth, "but if it doesn't, we won't survive to care."

citation.text: Thran Forge (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Karn vows not to take another's life though he would die for Gerrard.
timeline.quote: "Although I would give my life to protect Gerrard, my conscience will not let me take another's. There are many who would not hesitate."

citation.text: Steel Golem (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard says he sneezed and a drake bolted.
timeline.quote: "I sneezed, and it bolted."

citation.text: Timid Drake (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard's family is murdered by Phyrexian raiders, and Karn takes the boy to Sidar Kondo, who adopts him.
timeline.quote: took the little boy to an ally of Urza, the Jamuraan warlord Sidar Kondo , who adopted the boy

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Starke poisons the ritual paint, causing Vuel to fail his initiation.
timeline.quote: Starke poisoned the paint with which ritual tattoos were placed on his body

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard trains under Multani and befriends Rofellos and Mirri.
timeline.quote: Here he befriended the elf Rofellos and the cat -warrior Mirri .

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, Rofellos and Mirri join Sisay's Weatherlight crew after Gerrard loses a wager.
timeline.quote: with Gerrard having lost a tavern wager over a contest of knife-throwing against her

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Sisay and the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard falls in love with navigator Hanna.
timeline.quote: Gerrard fell in love with the ship's navigator, Hanna

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Sisay and the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians attack Crovax's Estate hunting Bloodline subjects; Rofellos is killed and Gerrard quits the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: During this battle, Rofellos was killed, which was too much for Gerrard.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Sisay and the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard leaves after Rofellos dies, leaving Hanna feeling abandoned; years later he rejoins and love rekindles.
timeline.quote: leading Hanna to feel abandoned and betrayed by his departure.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn rescues young Gerrard Capashen from Phyrexian raids on Benalia and brings him to Sidar Kondo.
timeline.quote: The golem rescued young Gerrard Capashen from the Phyrexian raids on Benalia

citation.text: "Karn", section "The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn is tricked into killing an innocent and frozen by the Touchstone; reactivated by Gerrard, he vows never to take a life.
timeline.quote: Karn took a vow of pacifism, swearing never again to take a life.

citation.text: "Karn", section "The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Rath Greven captures Karn and he is tortured in Volrath's Stronghold until Gerrard rescues him.
timeline.quote: Karn was captured by Greven as he refused to fight off his attackers

citation.text: "Karn", section "The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri becomes a student of Multani and befriends Gerrard and Rofellos, falling in love with Gerrard.
timeline.quote: she eventually became a student of Multani and a friend to Gerrard Capashen and Rofellos

citation.text: "Mirri", section "Time with Multani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On a trade mission to the Chitr'in, Keilic and Gerrard come to blows and Mirri throws herself between them.
timeline.quote: only stopped when Mirri threw herself between them, seeking to protect Gerrard

citation.text: "Mirri", section "Time with Multani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri joins the Weatherlight crew with Rofellos and Gerrard to find the Legacy artifacts.
timeline.quote: Mirri joined the crew of the Skyship Weatherlight in its quest to find the Legacy artifacts

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Rofellos is killed, Gerrard leaves the ship and Mirri goes with him, then travels to Llanowar to tell Rofellos's family.
timeline.quote: Rofellos was killed in the attack on Crovax's Estate

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Three years later Gerrard asks Mirri to be his Lieutenant and she rejoins the crew to rescue Captain Sisay.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Mirri both were instrumental in stopping the rampaging monster

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Rath, Greven il-Vec takes the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard falls overboard.
timeline.quote: they were unable to stop Greven il -Vec from taking the Legacy artifacts

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The elves capture Mirri and Hanna, but Gerrard is proclaimed the Korvecdal, leading to an alliance with Eladamri's rebels.
timeline.quote: leading to an alliance between the crew and the rebels

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri lets Crovax kill her so that Gerrard will save himself, fulfilling the spirit beast's prophecy.
timeline.quote: Mirri let Crovax kill her so that Gerrard would save himself.

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew takes Karn, Tahngarth and the Legacy artifacts hostage while Gerrard is knocked overboard.
timeline.quote: When Weatherlight planeshifted to Rath, it was ambushed by the Predator

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Predator battles Weatherlight over Urborg; Ertai captures Gerrard and teleports him into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: managed to capture Gerrard and teleport him directly into the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sisay meets Gerrard and others influenced by the bloodline project, who join the Weatherlight crew.
timeline.quote: Among them Gerrard , the true heir to the Legacy.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza breeds generations of the Capashen Clan, resulting in Gerrard Capashen.
timeline.quote: He began experiments on the Capashen Clan of Benalia , which eventually resulted in the birth of Gerrard Capashen .

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew take hostages.
timeline.quote: Predator' s crew took Karn , Tahngarth , and the Legacy artifacts hostage

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard quits the crew after Rofellos is killed at Crovax's Estate, confirming Tahngarth's suspicion.
timeline.quote: especially when the man quit the Weatherlight crew after the attack on Crovax's Estate

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard must face his blood brother Vuel, who as Volrath became Yawgmoth's first in command.
timeline.quote: becoming Yawgmoth's first in command

citation.text: "Weatherlight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard draws his sword and tells his crew the enemy should have brought a second ship.
timeline.quote: They should have brought a second ship!

citation.text: Gerrard's Battle Cry (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard orders slivers kept at sword's length, but their talons grow longer.
timeline.quote: Keep them at sword's length!

citation.text: Talon Sliver (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Orim tells Gerrard he must work hard yet appear effortless like the drake.
timeline.quote: You *must* do the same.

citation.text: Wind Drake (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard vanishes into the maw of trees as Hanna mourns.
timeline.quote: As Gerrard's form vanished into the maw of trees

citation.text: Abandon Hope (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard asks Orim whether it is too late for prayer as sludge shifts in the Death Pits.
timeline.quote: it's a little too late for prayer, isn't it?

citation.text: Death Pits of Rath (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath berates Greven for failing to capture Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Tell me again why you failed to capture Gerrard

citation.text: Fevered Convulsions (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Greven approach each other while moggs flee.
timeline.quote: As Gerrard and Greven neared each other

citation.text: No Quarter (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri's mushroom wine makes Gerrard sick.
timeline.quote: The mushroom wine made Gerrard's head spin

citation.text: Eladamri's Vineyard (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard escapes as a wurm eats merfolk.
timeline.quote: As Gerrard made his escape

citation.text: Rootbreaker Wurm (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee clutches his toy as horrors close in on Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Squee trembled and clutched his toy for comfort.

citation.text: Squee's Toy (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Oracle declares Gerrard the Korvecdal, convincing Eladamri to aid the Weatherlight crew.
timeline.quote: The Oracle's proclamation convinced Eladamri to aid the Weatherlight crew in their rescue mission

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Lord of Leaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard learns Starke betrayed the Phyrexians and had been feeding Sisay information about the Legacy.
timeline.quote: it was none other than Starke who had betrayed his masters and had supplied Sisay with information about the Legacy

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard reanimates the frozen Karn using his instinctive knowledge of artifice as heir to the Legacy.
timeline.quote: Gerrard managed to reanimate him with the instinctive knowledge of artifice he had as heir to the Legacy

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard is scarred by Greven il-Vec, falls into the Skyshroud, and learns from Oracle en-Vec that he is the Korvecdal.
timeline.quote: There he discovered the prophetess Oracle en -Vec who told him he was the Korvecdal

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, who had imprisoned Mirri and Hanna, releases them after Gerrard explains.
timeline.quote: He was brought to the home of the elvish lord Eladamri

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Dream Halls Gerrard realizes Volrath is his adoptive brother Vuel.
timeline.quote: Gerrard suddenly had flashbacks to his youth and the actions of Vuel, and realized the truth: Volrath was Vuel!

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard stabs his brother, but later learns he killed only a shapeshifter scapegoat.
timeline.quote: Volrath had used a scapegoat and that he had just killed another shapeshifter

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath orders Greven to intercept Weatherlight and bring back the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard.
timeline.quote: the evincar Volrath entrusted Greven with a crucial mission

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven captures Gerrard, but Vhati's attempt to assassinate Greven knocks Gerrard overboard.
timeline.quote: Vhati missed, but the impact knocked Gerrard overboard into the forest below.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Rath the Predator attacks; Karn and Tahngarth are captured and Gerrard is thrown overboard, so Hanna takes charge of the ship.
timeline.quote: Hanna took charge of the ship with Mirri 's support and landed the ship in the forest below.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, proclaimed the Korvecdal, allies the crew with the elven rebels, who help them into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: proclaimed the Korvecdal by the Oracle en -Vec , leading to an alliance between the crew and the rebels.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard leads Weatherlight to Rath, frees Sisay and retakes the Legacy from Volrath.
timeline.quote: where they freed Sisay and retook the Legacy from Volrath

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth convinces Gerrard to rejoin the crew after Sisay is taken to Rath.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth convinced Gerrard to rejoin the crew to help his friends

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth is mutated by the Phyrexians under Volrath, then freed before the process completes; he helps free Sisay and the crew escapes to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth had been mutated by the Phyrexians

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and the heroes of the Skyship Weatherlight set out on stormy Rath to find Volrath's stronghold.
timeline.quote: where Gerrard and the heroes of the Skyship Weatherlight set out to find Volrath 's stronghold

citation.text: "Tempest", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vuel's trial of climbing a plateau is sabotaged by Starke's poison; Gerrard saves his life, and Vuel is cast out of his clan, even by his father.
timeline.quote: Vuel was cast out of his clan as a failure, with even his father rejecting him.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath has Sisay abducted to lure the Weatherlight to Rath, ambushes it, and captures Tahngarth, Karn and the Legacy artifacts; Gerrard falls over Skyshroud Forest.
timeline.quote: He organized the abduction of Sisay to lure Weatherlight to Rath

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard kills a shapeshifted Volrath decoy; the real Volrath, in Takara's form, stows away on the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Volrath had shapeshifted into the form of Takara, which enabled him to stow away aboard Weatherlight as it fled the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Croag discovers Urza's Bloodline project and Yawgmoth raids Dominaria to kill the results, but Gerrard slips through.
timeline.quote: Urza had started the Bloodline project

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Lord of the Wastes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard unmasks the dead shapeshifter Vuel who had worn Volrath's features and calls it practice.
timeline.quote: I'll count this one as practice.

citation.text: Scapegoat (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard tells Volrath he now gets to die.
timeline.quote: Now you get to die.

citation.text: Smite (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard hesitates, looking up at the enemy ship, and the future changes.
timeline.quote: Gerrard hesitated, looking up at the enemy ship.

citation.text: Hesitation (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard comments on the bottomless pit.
timeline.quote: I'm sure it came with the place.

citation.text: Bottomless Pit (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard tells Crovax he will tire before his pain does.
timeline.quote: you will tire before it does.

citation.text: Megrim (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard studies the globe and realizes it shows Dominaria.
timeline.quote: This is Dominaria!

citation.text: Invasion Plans (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard did not expect a fight from the building itself.
timeline.quote: I expected a fight, but I didn't expect it from the building itself.

citation.text: Ensnaring Bridge (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax tears apart a shapeshifter in Selenia's guise inside the Stronghold.
